extension.description: See every branch of your repository as a commit graph in VS Code, and rebase, merge, cherry-pick or reset right from it.
command.endAllWorkspaceCodeReviews: End All Code Reviews in Workspace
command.endSpecificWorkspaceCodeReview: End a specific Code Review in Workspace...
command.resumeWorkspaceCodeReview: Resume a specific Code Review in Workspace...
command.goToCommit: Go to Commit in Easy Graph
config.builtin: Git config keys used by Easy Graph, with the same names as in Git. A key that is set overrides the Git config of the repository for the actions of Easy Graph, a key set to `null` or removed follows the Git config (`git config`, including its global and system levels). The default value keeps the behaviour of earlier settings; setting this object replaces it, so copy the keys you want to keep.
config.builtin.commit.gpgSign: Sign the commits created by Easy Graph (merge, pull, cherry-pick, revert, rebase, squash, edit message, apply patch).
config.builtin.core.abbrev: The number of characters of abbreviated commit hashes (4 - 40). When following Git, the length Git computes for the repository is used.
config.builtin.fetch.prune: Fetching with the Fetch button removes remote-tracking references that no longer exist on the remote, and the default of "Prune" when fetching a remote.
config.builtin.fetch.pruneTags: Fetching with the Fetch button removes local tags that no longer exist on the remote (requires Git >= 2.17.0 and pruning), and the default of "Prune Tags" when fetching a remote.
config.builtin.fetch.tags: Not a Git config key: `true` fetches all tags (`--tags`), `false` fetches no tags (`--no-tags`). When following Git, each remote's `remote.<name>.tagOpt` applies.
config.builtin.log.mailmap: Show the names and email addresses of authors and committers mapped by the repository's .mailmap file.
config.builtin.merge.ff: `false` checks "Create a new commit even if fast-forward is possible" by default in the Merge dialog.
config.builtin.pull.ff: `false` checks "Create a new commit even if fast-forward is possible" by default in the Pull dialog. When following Git, `merge.ff` applies if `pull.ff` isn't set.
config.builtin.push.autoSetupRemote: The default of "Set Upstream" in the Push Branch dialog.
config.builtin.status.showUntrackedFiles: Which untracked files the uncommitted changes show: `no` none, `normal` untracked files and one entry per untracked folder, `all` every untracked file.
config.builtin.tag.gpgSign: Sign the annotated tags added by Easy Graph.
config.title: Easy Graph
config.commitDetailsView.autoCenter: Automatically center the Commit Details View when it is opened.
config.commitDetailsView.autoScroll: Automatically scroll the view to show the commit when opening the Commit Details View.
config.commitDetailsView.fileView.fileTr: Render the File Tree in the Commit Details View in a compacted form, such that folders with a single child folder are compressed into a single combined folder element.
config.commitDetailsView.fileView.type: Sets the default type of File View used in the Commit Details View. This can be overridden per repository using the controls on the right side of the Commit Details View.
config.commitDetailsView.fileView.type.e: Display files in a tree structure.
Display files in a list (useful for repositories with deep folder structures).
config.commitDetailsView.hiddenFields: The fields to hide in the summary of the Commit Details View: "parents", "branches", "tags", "containedInBranches" (the "Contained in" row), "author", "committer", "date" (the author and committer dates), "changes" (the number of changed files and lines) and "notes".
config.commitDetailsView.location: Specifies where the Commit Details View is rendered in the Easy Graph View.
config.commitDetailsView.location.enum.I: Show the Commit Details View inline with the graph & commits.
config.commitDetailsView.location.enum.D: Show the Commit Details View docked to the bottom of the Easy Graph View.
config.contextMenuActionsVisibility: Customise which context menu actions are visible. For example, if you want to hide the rebase action from the branch context menu, a suitable value for this setting is `{ "branch": { "rebase": false } }`. For more information of how to configure this setting, view the documentation [here](https://github.com/hansu/vscode-git-graph/wiki/Extension-Settings#context-menu-actions-visibility).
config.contextMenuActionsVisibility.comm: Reset current Branch to this Commit...
Copy Commit Subjects Between to Clipboard
Copy Absolute File Path to Clipboard
Copy Relative File Path to Clipboard
Copy All Relative File Paths to Clipboard
config.customBranchGlobPatterns: An array of Custom Branch Glob Patterns to be shown in the 'Branches' dropdown. Example: [{"name": "Feature Requests", "glob": "heads/feature/*"}]
config.customBranchGlobPatterns.items.na: Name used to reference the pattern in the 'Branches' dropdown
config.customBranchGlobPatterns.items.gl: The Glob Pattern <glob-pattern>, as used in 'git log --glob=<glob-pattern>'. For example: heads/feature/*
config.customEmojiShortcodeMappings: An array of custom Emoji Shortcode mappings. Example: [{"shortcode": ":sparkles:", "emoji":"✨"}]
config.customPullRequestProviders: An array of custom Pull Request providers that can be used in the "Pull Request Creation" Integration. For information on how to configure this setting, see the documentation [here](https://github.com/hansu/vscode-git-graph/wiki/Configuring-a-custom-Pull-Request-Provider).
A unique, identifying, display name for the provider.

A template URL that can be used to create a Pull Request, after the $1 - $8 variables have been substituted to construct the final URL. For information on how to configure this setting, see the documentation [here](https://github.com/hansu/vscode-git-graph/wiki/Configuring-a-custom-Pull-Request-Provider).
config.date.format: Specifies the date format to be used in the "Date" column on the Easy Graph View.
config.date.format.enum.DateTime: Show the date and time (e.g. "24 Mar 2019 21:34")
config.date.format.enum.ISODateTime: Show the ISO date and time (e.g. "2019-03-24 21:34")
config.date.format.enum.Custom: Show the date using the format specified by "easy-graph.date.customFormat"
config.date.customFormat: The date format used when `#easy-graph.date.format#` is "Custom". Supported tokens: `YYYY`, `YY`, `MMM` (e.g. Mar), `MM`, `M`, `DD`, `D`, `ddd` (e.g. Sun), `HH`, `H`, `hh`, `h`, `mm`, `ss`, `A` (AM/PM). Text inside square brackets is shown as is (e.g. `[at] HH:mm`).
config.disableRefreshWhenShown: Don't reload the Easy Graph View each time it's shown again (e.g. when switching back to its tab), keep showing the previously loaded graph instead. Use the Refresh button to update it. Only effective when the view's context is retained (see `easy-graph.retainContextWhenHidden`).
config.date.type: Specifies the date type to be displayed in the "Date" column on the Easy Graph View.
config.date.type.enum.AuthorDate: Use the author date of a commit.
config.date.type.enum.CommitDate: Use the committer date of a commit.
config.defaultColumnVisibility: An object specifying the default visibility of the Date, Author & Commit columns. Example: {"Date": true, "Author": true, "Commit": true}
config.toolbarButtonVisibility: An object specifying the visibility of the items of the control bar. Example: {"Display": true, "Scope": false}
config.toolbarButtonVisibility.Remotes.t: Legacy key of Scope (the Scope dropdown replaced the Remotes checkbox), FALSE also hides the Scope dropdown
Legacy key of Display (the Display dropdown replaced the Simplify and Overview checkboxes), FALSE also hides the Display dropdown
config.toolbarButtonVisibility.Paths.tit: Visibility of the Paths Filter dropdown
config.dialog.addTag.pushToRemote: Default state of the field indicating whether the tag should be pushed to a remote once it is added.
config.dialog.addTag.type: Default type of the tag being added.
config.dialog.applyStash.reinstateIndex: Default state of the "Reinstate Index" checkbox.
config.dialog.cherryPick.noCommit: Default state of the "No Commit" checkbox.
config.dialog.cherryPick.recordOrigin: Default state of the "Record Origin" checkbox.
config.dialog.createBranch.checkOut: Default state of the "Check out" checkbox.
config.dialog.deleteBranch.forceDelete: Default state of the "Force Delete" checkbox.
config.dialog.deleteBranch.deleteOnRemot: Default state of the "Delete this branch on the remote(s)" checkbox (and of the "Delete on Remotes" checkbox when deleting multiple branches).
config.dialog.fetchIntoLocalBranch.force: Default state of the "Force Fetch" checkbox.
config.dialog.general.referenceInputSpac: Specifies a substitution that is automatically performed when space characters are entered or pasted into reference inputs on dialogs (e.g. Create Branch, Add Tag, etc.).
Replace space characters with hyphens, for example: "new branch" -> "new-branch".
Replace space characters with underscores, for example: "new branch" -> "new_branch".
config.dialog.merge.noCommit: Default state of the "No Commit" checkbox.
config.dialog.merge.allowUnrelatedHistor: Default state of the "Allow unrelated histories" checkbox.
config.dialog.merge.squashCommits: Default state of the "Squash Commits" checkbox.
config.dialog.merge.squashMessageFormat: Specifies the message format used for the squashed commit (when the "Squash Commits" option is selected).
Use the squash message generated by Easy Graph.
Use the detailed squash message generated by Git (stored in .git/SQUASH_MSG).
Use the squash message generated by Easy Graph, followed by the subjects of all the squashed commits (one per line).
config.dialog.popStash.reinstateIndex: Default state of the "Reinstate Index" checkbox.
config.dialog.pullBranch.squashCommits: Default state of the "Squash Commits" checkbox.
config.dialog.pullBranch.squashMessageFo: Specifies the message format used for the squashed commit (when the "Squash Commits" option is selected).
Use the squash message generated by Easy Graph.
Use the detailed squash message generated by Git (stored in .git/SQUASH_MSG).
Use the squash message generated by Easy Graph, followed by the subjects of all the squashed commits (one per line).
config.dialog.pushBranch.mode: Default "Push Mode" of the Push Branch dialog.
config.dialog.rebase.ignoreDate: Checkbox "Ignore Date (non-interactive rebase only)" active by default.
config.dialog.rebase.launchInteractiveRe: Checkbox "Interactive Rebase (launch in new Terminal)" active by default.
config.dialog.resetCurrentBranchToCommit: Default mode to be used for the reset action.
Soft - Keep all changes, but reset head
Mixed - Keep working tree, but reset index
config.dialog.resetUncommittedChanges.mo: Default mode to be used for the reset action.
Mixed - Keep working tree, but reset index
config.dialog.stashUncommittedChanges.in: Default state of the "Include Untracked" checkbox.
config.enhancedAccessibility: Visual file change A|M|D|R|U indicators in the Commit Details View for users with colour blindness. In the future, this setting will enable any additional accessibility related features of Easy Graph that aren't enabled by default.
config.excludeBranchGlobPatterns: An array of branch names or glob patterns to exclude from the Easy Graph View when showing all branches, e.g. `gh-pages` or `wip/*` (excludes matching local branches and the matching remote-tracking branches of all remotes), or `remotes/origin/wip/*` (only excludes matching remote-tracking branches). Excluded branches can still be viewed by selecting them in the Branches dropdown. Commits that are also reachable from other branches or HEAD are still shown.
config.fileEncoding: The character set encoding used when retrieving a specific version of repository files (e.g. in the Diff View). When this setting isn't configured, Visual Studio Code's `#files.encoding#` setting (for the repository) is used. A list of all supported encodings can be found [here](https://github.com/ashtuchkin/iconv-lite/wiki/Supported-Encodings).
config.findMatchHighlightColour: The colour used to highlight the matches of the Find Widget (HEX or RGB, e.g. `#ffcc0080`). Leave empty to use the `editor.findMatchHighlightBackground` colour of the current theme.
config.flashColour: The colour used to flash a commit after jumping to it (e.g. Scroll to HEAD). HEX or RGB, e.g. `#00aaff`. Leave empty to use the colour used to highlight find matches.
config.fontFamily: The font family used in the Easy Graph View (CSS `font-family` syntax, e.g. `Menlo, monospace`). Leave empty to use the font of the workbench.
config.findWidget.searchColumns: The columns that the Find Widget searches. "Description" covers the commit message, and the branch, tag & stash labels. Hidden columns are never searched.
config.graph.colours: Specifies the colours used on the graph.
config.graph.showBranchColourOnRows: Display a thin strip with the colour of the commit's branch on the graph at the left of each commit's description.
config.graph.style: Specifies the style of the graph.
config.graph.style.enum.rounded: Use smooth curves when transitioning between branches on the graph.
config.graph.style.enum.angular: Use angular lines when transitioning between branches on the graph.
config.graph.uncommittedChanges: Specifies how the Uncommitted Changes are displayed on the graph.
config.graph.uncommittedChanges.enum.Ope: Display the Uncommitted Changes as a grey open circle, connected to the commit referenced by HEAD with a solid grey line. The current file system's state is therefore always displayed as an open circle.

Display the Uncommitted Changes as a grey closed circle, connected to the commit referenced by HEAD with a dotted grey line. The commit referenced by HEAD is therefore always displayed as an open circle.
config.integratedTerminalShell: Specifies the path and filename of the Shell executable to be used by the Visual Studio Code Integrated Terminal, when it is opened by Easy Graph. For example, to use Git Bash on Windows this setting would commonly be set to "C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe". If this setting is left blank, the default Shell is used.
config.keyboardShortcut.modifier: The modifier key of the Find keyboard shortcut (F) of the Easy Graph View. With "CTRL" or "CMD", only that key is used and the other one is left to Visual Studio Code.
config.keyboardShortcut.modifier.enum.ct: Respond to either the CTRL key or the CMD (Meta) key.
Only respond to the CTRL key.
config.keyboardShortcut.modifier.enum.cm: Only respond to the CMD key (the Meta / Windows key on Windows and Linux).
config.externalDiffToolArgs: Additional arguments passed to `git difftool` when opening the external diff tool (for both the directory diff and the diff of a single file), e.g. `--no-symlinks`.
config.logGitCommandOutput: Write the output of the Git commands run by actions (e.g. the messages of Git hooks) to the "Easy Graph" Output Channel.
config.markdown: Parse and render a frequently used subset of inline Markdown formatting rules in commit messages and tag details (bold, italics, bold & italics, and inline code blocks).
config.maxDepthOfRepoSearch: Specifies the maximum depth of subfolders to search when discovering repositories in the workspace. Note: Sub-repos are not automatically detected when searching subfolders, however they can be manually added by running the command "Easy Graph: Add Git Repository" in the Command Palette.
config.openNewTabEditorGroup: Specifies the Editor Group where Easy Graph should open new tabs, when performing the following actions from the Easy Graph View: Viewing the Visual Studio Code Diff View, Opening a File, Viewing a File at a Specific Revision.
config.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.Active: Open the new tab in the Active Editor Group.
config.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.Beside: Open the new tab beside the Easy Graph View (when it's open in the editor), otherwise beside the Active Editor Group.
config.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.One: Open the new tab in the First Editor Group.
config.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.Two: Open the new tab in the Second Editor Group.
config.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.Three: Open the new tab in the Third Editor Group.
config.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.Four: Open the new tab in the Fourth Editor Group.
config.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.Five: Open the new tab in the Fifth Editor Group.
config.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.Six: Open the new tab in the Sixth Editor Group.
config.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.Seven: Open the new tab in the Seventh Editor Group.
config.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.Eight: Open the new tab in the Eighth Editor Group.
config.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.Nine: Open the new tab in the Ninth Editor Group.
config.openToTheRepoOfTheActiveTextEdito: Open the Easy Graph View to the repository containing the active Text Editor document.
config.referenceLabels.alignment: Specifies how branch and tag reference labels are aligned for each commit.
config.referenceLabels.alignment.enum.No: Show branch & tag labels on the left of the commit message in the 'Description' column.
config.referenceLabels.alignment.enum.Br: Show branch labels on the left of the commit message in the 'Description' column, and tag labels on the right.
Show branch labels aligned to the graph in the 'Graph' column, and tag labels on the right in the 'Description' column.
config.referenceLabels.combineLocalAndRe: Combine local and remote branch labels if they refer to the same branch, and are on the same commit.
config.repository.backupBeforeDangerousA: Before a dangerous action (e.g. reset, rebase, drop, squash, edit message, delete branch or force push), create a backup reference of the affected branch under `refs/easy-graph/backup/`. Backups can be restored or deleted with the command "Easy Graph: Manage Backups...".
config.repository.commits.fetchAvatars: Fetch avatars of commit authors and committers. By enabling this setting, you consent to commit author and committer email addresses being sent GitHub, GitLab or Gravatar, depending on the repositories remote origin.
config.repository.commits.initialLoad: Specifies the number of commits to initially load.
config.repository.commits.loadMore: Specifies the number of additional commits to load when the "Load More Commits" button is pressed, or more commits are automatically loaded.
config.repository.commits.loadMoreAutoma: When the view has been scrolled to the bottom, automatically load more commits if they exist (instead of having to press the "Load More Commits" button).
config.repository.commits.mute.commitsTh: Display commits that aren't ancestors of the checked-out branch / commit with a muted text color. Muting will only occur if the commit referenced by HEAD is within the loaded commits on the Easy Graph View.
config.repository.commits.mute.mergeComm: Display merge commits with a muted text color.
config.repository.commits.order: Specifies the order of commits on the Easy Graph View. See [git log](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-log#_commit_ordering) for more information on each order option. This can be overridden per repository via the Easy Graph View's Column Header Context Menu.
config.repository.commits.order.enum.dat: Show commits in the commit timestamp order.
config.repository.commits.order.enum.aut: Show commits in the author timestamp order.
config.repository.commits.order.enum.top: Avoid showing commits on multiple lines of history intermixed.
config.repository.commits.showSignatureS: Show the commit's signature status to the right of the Committer in the Commit Details View (only for signed commits). Hovering over the signature icon displays a tooltip with the signature details. Requires Git (>= 2.4.0) & GPG (or equivalent) to be installed on the same machine that is running Visual Studio Code.
config.repository.fetchOnLoad: Automatically fetch from the remote(s) of a repository when it's opened in the Easy Graph View (at most once every 5 minutes per repository).
config.repository.includeCommitsMentione: Select Reflog in the initial Scope of repositories, which includes the commits only mentioned by reflogs in the Easy Graph View (only applies when showing all branches). The Scope can be changed per repository from the Scope dropdown in the Easy Graph View's Control Bar.
config.repository.onLoad.scrollToHead: Automatically scroll the Easy Graph View to be centered on the commit referenced by HEAD. If the commit referenced by HEAD is older than the loaded commits, more commits are loaded until it's shown.
config.repository.onLoad.showCheckedOutB: Show the checked out branch when a repository is loaded in the Easy Graph View. This setting can be used in conjunction with "Repository > On Load: Show Specific Branches". Default: false (show all branches)
config.repository.onLoad.showSpecificBra: Show specific branches when a repository is loaded in the Easy Graph View. Branches can be specified as follows: A local branch name (e.g. `master`), a remote-tracking branch name prefixed with "remotes/" (e.g. `remotes/origin/master`), or a glob pattern defined in `easy-graph.customBranchGlobPatterns` prefixed with "--glob=" (e.g. `--glob=heads/feature/*`). This setting can be used in conjunction with "Repository > On Load: Show Checked Out Branch". Default: [] (show all branches)

A local branch name (e.g. "master"), a remote-tracking branch name prefixed with "remotes/" (e.g. "remotes/origin/master"), or a glob pattern defined in easy-graph.customBranchGlobPatterns prefixed with "--glob=" (e.g. "--glob=heads/feature/*"). The pattern must already exist in easy-graph.customBranchGlobPatterns.
config.repository.onlyShowRemoteBranches: When showing all branches, only show the remote-tracking branches that have a corresponding local branch (a local branch with the same name, or a local branch tracking it).
config.repository.onlyFollowFirstParent: Only follow the first parent of commits when discovering the commits to load in the Easy Graph View. See [--first-parent](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-log#Documentation/git-log.txt---first-parent) to find out more about this setting. This can be overridden per repository with First Parent in the Display dropdown of the Easy Graph View's Control Bar.
config.repository.singleAuthorSelect: Enables the selection of only a single author from the Authors dropdown. Multiple authors can be selected by 'Ctrl' (or 'Cmd' on macOS) + click.
config.repository.singleBranchSelect: Enables the selection of only a single branch from the Branches dropdown. Multiple branches can be selected by 'Ctrl' (or 'Cmd' on macOS) + click.
config.repository.showCommitsOnlyReferen: Show Commits that are only referenced by tags in Easy Graph.
config.repository.showRemoteBranches: Select Remote in the initial Scope of repositories, which shows the remote branches in Easy Graph. The Scope can be changed per repository from the Scope dropdown in the Easy Graph View's Control Bar.
config.repository.simplifyByDecoration: Show branch topology by omitting commits that are not referenced by tags. This can be overridden per repository with Simplify in the Display dropdown of the Easy Graph View's Control Bar.
config.repository.showRemoteHeads: Show Remote HEAD Symbolic References in Easy Graph (e.g. "origin/HEAD").
config.repository.showStashes: Show Stashes in Easy Graph by default. This can be overridden per repository in the Easy Graph View's Repository Settings Widget.
config.repository.showTags: Show Tags in Easy Graph by default. This can be overridden per repository in the Easy Graph View's Repository Settings Widget.
config.repository.showUncommittedChanges: Show uncommitted changes. If you work on large repositories, disabling this setting can reduce the load time of the Easy Graph View.
config.repositoryDropdownOrder: Specifies the order that repositories are sorted in the repository dropdown on the Easy Graph View (only visible when more than one repository exists in the current Visual Studio Code Workspace).
config.repositoryDropdownOrder.enum.Full: Sort repositories alphabetically by the full path of the repository.
config.repositoryDropdownOrder.enum.Name: Sort repositories alphabetically by the name of the repository.
config.repositoryDropdownOrder.enum.Work: Sort repositories according to the Visual Studio Code Workspace Folder order, then alphabetically by the full path of the repository.
config.repositories: Repositories to always show in Easy Graph, even if they aren't found by the workspace search (e.g. outside of the workspace, or deeper than `#easy-graph.maxDepthOfRepoSearch#`). Supports absolute paths, `~`, `${workspaceFolder}`, `${workspaceFolder:name}`, and paths relative to the first workspace folder.
config.repoSearchExclude: Glob patterns of folders to skip when searching the workspace for repositories (relative to the workspace folder, e.g. `**/node_modules`). The patterns enabled in `#files.exclude#` are skipped as well.
config.retainContextWhenHidden: Specifies if the Easy Graph View's Visual Studio Code context is kept when the panel is no longer visible (e.g. moved to background tab). Enabling this setting will make Easy Graph load significantly faster when switching back to the Easy Graph tab, however has a higher memory overhead.
config.showStatusBarItem: Show a Status Bar Item that opens the Easy Graph View when clicked.
config.sourceCodeProviderIntegrationLoca: Specifies where the "View Easy Graph" action appears on the title of SCM Providers.
Show the 'View Easy Graph' action on the title of SCM Providers
Show the 'View Easy Graph' action in the 'More Actions...' menu on the title of SCM Providers
config.stickyHeader: Keeps the header visible when the view is scrolled
config.toggleViewOnCommand: When the Easy Graph View is the active editor, running the "View Easy Graph" command again (e.g. clicking the Status Bar Item or the Source Control icon) closes it.
config.viewLocation: Specifies where to display the Easy Graph view by default.
config.viewLocation.enum.editor: Display Easy Graph in the editor area (traditional view)
config.viewLocation.enum.panel: Display Easy Graph in the panel area (bottom/side panel)
config.viewLocation.enum.both: Allow both display modes (use specific commands to open in each location)
